description: Inventory quotes: mid and tick in USD, inventory weights in percent, spread/skew/cap in basis points. Skew is bps per 10 percentage points of inventory deviation. Returns results, conditions, assumptions, an editable link, share page and PNG. No account access or order execution.

current.description: Current base inventory percentage, or current balance in dollars in recovery.

include_image.description: Also inline a PNG no wider than 1000 pixels. Image URL is always returned.

skew.description: Quote shift in basis points per 10 percentage points of inventory deviation.

skewCap.description: Maximum quote-center shift in basis points.

spread.description: Full quoted spread in basis points.

target.description: Trade target price, or target inventory percentage for inventory quotes.
